record: Pre-F1 run specification: owner decisions on how the frozen protocol is executed
status: pre-F1. Hashed in the v1.0.5 adoption record (adoption_record_v1.0.5.json) and, at F1, into docs/freeze/pretest_freeze.json (protocol Sec. 'Stage F1', items 2, 4 and 7).

decisions.decision: Option A. The adopted RQ is kept verbatim. F-B (H2a; H2-3, H2-4) compares at matched recommendation volume per repository against the method/argument arms. F-A compares at natural coverage against the algorithm-name mapping, the method/argument-only mapping and the external tools. Every F-A finding is described as a natural-coverage comparison; no claim of superior correctness over algorithm-family baselines at comparable coverage.

pqscan:B1-algorithm is the single 'simple algorithm-name mapping' baseline in F-A, with the mappings already defined in pqscan/baselines/simple.py (ALG_RULE). pqscan:B1-dual is reported descriptively only, outside F-A, because it emits DUAL recommendations rather than a specific migration choice. The scanner is not modified or rebuilt for this decision.

Approval of the complete pre-F1 decision register resolving the 21 findings of the isolated AI specification review of protocol v1.0.4, including the H1/H3/H4 interpretations H-1 to H-6 (with owner choices C1, C2 and C3 and the eligible-only H4 sensitivity) and the H1b baseline set (F12). No hypothesis, threshold, primary metric, confirmatory family, baseline, D7 or D15 changed.

G02: obvious_from_name nullable (null on ineligible records), data-contract correction with migration. G03: F03 primary sampling and annotation rule retained; units clarified; additional same-family calls are notes. G08: H4 Part 1 set = the F-A baseline set. G10: signed guard and threshold retained; an additional pre-specified calibration scenario must run and pass before F1.

G08 confirmation (third review TB01): H4 Part 1 = exactly the eight registered F-A baselines (six external tools, pqscan:B1-algorithm, pqscan:B2-method-args); inclusion by F-A membership only; the other five pqscan arms are reported separately.
Pre-F1 analysis decisions TA03, TA04, TA05, TA08, TA09, TA10, TA17, TA22, TA28, W6, N1, D14 as recommended; TA01 conditional on historical verification (outcome: S16 not excluded; F1 blocked).

F-B.coverage: matched recommendation volume per repository (analysis plan Secs. 4-7)

F-A.coverage: natural coverage (no matching, no guard; analysis plan Sec. 9)
F-A.test: one-sided exact McNemar on the pooled discordant pairs over sites where both ran
F-A.multiplicity: Holm across the baselines that ran
F-A.reporting: always described as a natural-coverage comparison, with coverage printed alongside (D7 Option A)

descriptive_only.pqscan:B1-dual: Algorithm-name convention that refuses to choose for multi-purpose algorithms (RSA, EC, unresolved -> DUAL). Reported descriptively, outside F-A and outside every confirmatory family (D15).

interpretations.H-1: H1a and H1b keep their status as pre-registered threshold decision rules, without any multiplicity-controlled inference. H3 and H4 remain pre-specified secondary/descriptive analyses, without a confirmatory or family-wise error claim. The confirmatory families remain F-A and F-B only.
interpretations.H-2: H1a is met if and only if the point estimate of its proportion is >= 0.25. H1b is met if and only if, for every tool in the H1b set, the point estimate of (harmful + UNDECIDED + UNJUSTIFIED) / n_exec is >= 0.10, where harmful = INCORRECT with a harm category (scoring policy). Wilson 95% confidence intervals are always reported. Neither threshold changes. H1a numerator (owner decision TA08, r6): eligible primary-set test sites with obvious_from_name = false, including UNKNOWN/INDETERMINATE sites (their role does not follow from the name); denominator: all eligible primary-set test sites. Reported alongside: the evidence_needed categories and a sensitivity excluding INDETERMINATE sites.
interpretations.H-3: The primary H1 results use the primary-set eligible sites of the seven test repositories, with F2-frozen owner-final labels; 'the full real set' in the RQ1 row is read this way. Development and validation results are reported separately and never pooled with test results. For tool j, the H1b denominator is n_exec,j: the eligible sites on which j ran (scoring policy Sec. 5). Execution failures per tool are reported separately, by count and reason.
interpretations.H-4: The H1b set is pqcheck, pqc-audit, PostQuant, qsafe, QSA-regex and pqblocks-scan (the external tools; RQ1 asks about existing scanners). The internal arms pqscan:B1-algorithm and pqscan:B2-method-args are reported separately and are not in H1b. Excluded, with reasons: CBOMkit (not run, decision D4: an inventory tool without migration advice); Mehl's scanner (produces repository-level readiness labels and no per-site migration recommendation by design (Mehl 2026, p. 3), so it cannot be scored on the recommendation outcome; a source repository exists (owner decision D14, 19 Nov 2026)); pqscan:B1-dual (descriptive only, D15: it emits dual recommendations, not a specific migration choice). A tool in the set that runs but produces no scoreable output is reported as not assessable, and H1b is reported as not decidable for it.

H-5 (H3).status: pre-specified secondary/descriptive analysis; no multiplicity-controlled or confirmatory claim (H-1)
H-5 (H3).population: Dataset B, the seven test repositories, primary-set eligible sites; n_r = sites where pqscan ran (the common evaluable set of both arms; arm-level failures reported)

arms.always_recommend: pqscan:B3-full-noabst (Module C full, tier threshold T0). It recommends at every site where it reaches a determinate role, at any evidence tier, but it still abstains on UNKNOWN roles, so it is not literally universal recommendation; its natural coverage is reported explicitly and is not assumed to be 100%.

H-5 (H3).target_count: K_r(c) = ceil(c * n_r), c held as an exact fraction
H-5 (H3).t2_to_coverage: If R_r^T2 >= K_r(c), withdraw R_r^T2 - K_r(c) recommendations of the T2 policy: evidence tier ascending (T2 before T3), then ascending SHA-256 of '20261113|H3-T2|<repo>|<site_id>' within a tier (the deterministic rule of H2 matching); a withdrawn recommendation is judged ABSTAIN; the order does not depend on c, so kept sets are nested. If R_r^T2 < K_r(c), repository r cannot reach c; nothing is extrapolated.
H-5 (H3).always_recommend_comparison: B3-full-noabst at its own natural coverage (sum_r R_r^AR / sum_r n_r, reported). T2 versus always-recommend is a natural-coverage comparison, never a matched-coverage one, and is always labelled so.
H-5 (H3).random_withholding: Seeds 20261113:withhold:001 ... 20261113:withhold:100, frozen before F1. For seed s, the per-repository order of B3-full-noabst's recommended sites is the ascending SHA-256 (hexadecimal text) of UTF-8 '<s>|H3-withhold|<repo>|<site_id>'; no random-number generator is used. At coverage c the first K_r(c) sites keep their recommendation and the rest are judged ABSTAIN. The same order is used at 70%, 80% and 90%, so the subsets are nested. If R_r^AR < K_r(c), the random comparison cannot reach c.
H-5 (H3).estimability_C1: If any of the seven repositories has n_r = 0, every coverage point is NOT ESTIMABLE. Point c is estimable only if, in all seven repositories, R_r^T2 >= K_r(c) and R_r^AR >= K_r(c); otherwise the pooled point is NOT ESTIMABLE. Per-repository results are always reported where available. No repository is removed and the population never changes between points.
H-5 (H3).harmful_rate: HR(c) = sum_r H_r(c) / sum_r n_r (frozen scoring: harmful = INCORRECT with a harm category; denominator n_exec); HR_T2(c); HR_AR at natural coverage; HR_k(c) per seed and HR_rand(c) = mean over the 100 seeds.
H-5 (H3).reported_per_point: HR_T2(c), HR_AR and HR_rand(c); the random distribution (minimum, 2.5th percentile, median, 97.5th percentile, maximum) and its standard deviation across seeds; a within-repository site bootstrap 95% CI for HR_T2(c) - HR_rand(c) (1,000 resamples, seed 20261113); per-repository values; the existing risk-coverage curves and AURC, unchanged.
H-5 (H3).decision_C2: At each coverage point c in {70%, 80%, 90%}, evaluated separately, the point comparison holds if HR_T2(c) < HR_AR (natural coverage) and HR_T2(c) < HR_rand(c), strictly, on point estimates. The overall H3 criterion is MET only if all three points are estimable and the point comparison holds at every point; NOT MET if all three are estimable and any comparison fails; NOT ASSESSABLE if any point is not estimable. Every estimable point is always presented separately.
H-5 (H3).code_note: New H3 code goes in a new module: pqscan/bench/stats.py (risk_coverage, aurc) belongs to the E30 calibration closure and is not modified.
H-5 (H3).always_recommend_reporting_TA03: The always-recommend half of decision C2 compares at different coverages and is therefore coverage-confounded under the per-site harmful rate (owner decision TA03, r6): it is always printed with both arms' coverages and with each arm's per-recommendation risk (harmful / recommended). The random-withholding half is the coverage-matched comparison. Decision rule C2 is unchanged.
H-5 (H3).bootstrap_procedure_TA28: Bootstrap for HR_T2(c) - HR_rand(c) (owner decision TA28, r6): 1,000 resamples drawn with numpy default_rng(20261113); in each resample, sites are resampled with replacement within each repository; K_r(c) is recomputed from the resampled n_r; the T2 withdrawal uses the frozen SHA-256 order (copies of a duplicated site are ordered by copy index); HR_rand(c) is recomputed as the mean over the 100 frozen withholding orders, each applied to the resampled sites; the 95% CI is the percentile interval. A resample in which a point is not estimable is counted and reported; the interval uses the estimable resamples.

H-6 (H4).status: pre-specified secondary/descriptive analysis; no confirmatory or family-wise error claim (H-1)
H-6 (H4).data: Dataset A's frozen base-variant pairs (b, o): base case b's identity instance and its variant under operator o, one site each. Pairs per operator: alias-import, wrapper-function, class-method 61 each; cross-function, dict-dispatch, loaded-key 48 each.
H-6 (H4).tool_set: Every runnable baseline and pqscan arm is listed by name in this run specification before the evaluation; the proposed analyser is pqscan:B4-full-T2. Exclusions are pre-specified with reasons only.
H-6 (H4).outcomes: Classification outcome: no finding, or a finding with its reported category (each tool's field fixed in the inventory). Recommendation outcome: (action, rec_class) in the common vocabulary: RECOMMEND with its class, FLAG_NO_TARGET, ABSTAIN or NO_FINDING.
H-6 (H4).denominator_C3: N(o, j) = the pairs for operator o on which tool j ran on both the identity and the variant instance, eligible and ineligible cases included. Execution-failure pairs are counted and reported separately and excluded from the rate. The same N(o, j) is used for classification and recommendation flips.
H-6 (H4).flip_rates: FR_cls(o, j) = #{pairs in N(o, j) whose classification outcome differs between identity and variant} / |N(o, j)|; FR_rec(o, j) = #{pairs in N(o, j) whose recommendation outcome differs between identity and variant} / |N(o, j)|.
H-6 (H4).eligible_only_sensitivity: Eligible-only recommendation-flip sensitivity (H4; secondary; reported separately). FR_rec^elig(o, j) = #{pairs in N^elig(o, j) whose recommendation outcome differs between the identity and the variant instance} / |N^elig(o, j)|, where N^elig(o, j) is the set of base–variant pairs for operator o whose frozen Dataset A label is eligible and on which tool j ran successfully on both the identity and the variant instance. It uses the same common recommendation-outcome vocabulary as the primary rate. It is reported separately from the primary all-pair classification and recommendation flip rates, FR_cls(o, j) and FR_rec(o, j), and is never substituted for them in the primary H4 decision.
H-6 (H4).decision: All decisions use point estimates, with Wilson 95% confidence intervals reported for every rate. Part 1: for every tool j in the pre-specified H4 baseline set, at least one pre-registered operator o - loaded-key included, because the original hypothesis names it - has FR_cls(o, j) >= 0.30 or FR_rec(o, j) >= 0.30 (wording kept: 'classification or recommendation'). Both flip types are always reported separately. The prediction (loaded-key, cross-function) is reported as confirmed or not. loaded-key is reported separately as an evidence-condition change, not a semantics-preserving transformation. Part 2: for the proposed analyser, separately under alias-import and under wrapper-function: classification stability 1 - FR_cls and recommendation stability 1 - FR_rec are reported separately; a pair is invariant only if neither its classification nor its recommendation flipped; Part 2 is met if the invariant share is >= 0.90 for both operators. loaded-key never enters the invariance calculations.

tool_inventory_G08.part1_inclusion_criterion: Membership in the registered F-A baseline set, exactly eight identifiers: the six registered external tools, pqscan:B1-algorithm and pqscan:B2-method-args. Not based on evidence tier (T0 or T2) and not on whether an arm is external or internal. The other five pqscan arms (B4-full-T2, B1-dual, B3-full-noabst, method-args-recv-T0, method-only-T0) are reported separately and are never added to Part 1.
tool_inventory_G08.h1b_versus_h4_sets: H1b and H4 Part 1 both say 'every baseline' but use different, separately registered sets on purpose. H1b (RQ1) asks about existing scanners, so its set is the six external tools (F12, H-4). H4 Part 1 (RQ4) tests whether transformations change the outcome of any baseline method against which the proposed analyser is compared, so its set is the full F-A baseline set (eight members, owner decision G08). The H1b set is unchanged; the set used is printed next to every H1b and H4 result.

owner_confirmation.decision: Confirmed: H4 Part 1 contains exactly the eight registered F-A baselines; the remaining five pqscan arms are reported separately; no threshold, hypothesis, metric, method or estimand changes.

H-6 (H4).operator_quantifier_TA04: Part 1 uses the per-tool reading (for each baseline some operator meets the threshold; owner decision TA04, r6). Also reported, descriptively only: whether one operator meets FR >= 0.30 for all eight baselines.
H-6 (H4).population_TA05: Part 1 uses all base-variant pairs (61 or 48 per operator). Part 2 (the proposed analyser's invariance) uses the 30 synthetic-holdout base cases as its primary population, because the 31 synthetic-dev base cases were visible during development; Part 2 on all pairs is reported as well (owner decision TA05, r6).

pre_f1_analysis_decisions_r6.TA17_k_equals_7: The Experiment E driver asserts that exactly the seven test repositories are present before any comparison is analysed, so K = 7 always (owner decision TA17, r6); pqscan/bench/h2.py, part of the calibration closure, is not changed.
pre_f1_analysis_decisions_r6.TA01_s16: Historical verification of S16 (19 Nov 2026; docs/audit/ta01_s16_historical_verification.md): the planning calibration observed S16 (random repositories) above the criterion before protocol v1.0.4 was adopted; the adopted plan Sec. 11 item 2 lists all 18 single-comparison scenarios, S16 included, without an exemption; the exemption exists only in the acceptance script. S16 is therefore NOT excluded retrospectively: acceptance criterion 2 is not met under the adopted text, and F1 stays blocked until an adopted and calibrated solution exists (owner decision required).
